items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison; informed he will be inactive for Sunday vs Lions as details finalized.
items.implication: Immediate removal from lineups; opens targets for other ARI WRs/TE
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Michael Wilson, Trey McBride

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown.
items.implication: Eagles RB/WR committee shifts; handcuff and secondary WRs elevated
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down for backups; more targets to Goedert/others

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Sunday night vs Falcons (ankle); also Hendrickson/Jurgens out.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgraded; backup QB starts, Henry/ Flowers/Likely/Andrews roles shift
items.opportunity: More volume potential for Derrick Henry, Zay Flowers, Isaiah Likely

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN and expected to start for Commanders after elbow injury.
items.why: Upgraded to full participant; coach confirms start with brace
items.opportunity: Full QB snaps, designed runs, pass volume for McLaurin etc.

items.implication: WAS WR targets open further with Daniels back
items.opportunity: More volume to McLaurin, Deebo, others

items.implication: IND WR targets to Downs, Pierce, Warren TE
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route share for Josh Downs, Alec Pierce, Tyler Warren

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance); ETR projects him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger workload expected after Week 4 criticism. Gut says much better role.
items.why: Not on final report; fan/media pressure on prior usage; full-go comments
items.implication: Strong RB start/DFS play; clear lead back projection
items.opportunity: Expanded carries, snaps, red-zone vs prior limited role

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt, James).
items.implication: LAC WR targets redistribute to McConkey, Hampton etc.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Ladd McConkey, Omarion Hampton

items.text: Broncos place emerging WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR (ankle); miss next 4 games, eligible Nov 8. Promoted Lil'Jordan Humphrey.
items.implication: DEN WR depth thins; more to Sutton, others
items.opportunity: Target share bump for Courtland Sutton, RJ Harvey etc.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume and RZ vs struggling defense.
items.why: Target volume + matchup; amplified by MHJ inactive/trade

items.text: Fears multi-risk for Malik Nabers long-term: knee, shoulder, potential McCarthy QB, coaching 'boomer' scheme; frustrated by low post-half targets. Still good this week but stacked risks.
items.why: Sore knee DNP, shoulder history, QB/coaching concerns, frustration
items.implication: Monitor closely; short-term playable but ROS caution

items.text: Loves Nico Collins vs Titans as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft secondary.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift; red-zone volume
